answer: One slot per identity, claimed with a 70-credit deposit. Slots run a spiral roster, scattering a farmer's slots. Each epoch the holder files a whisper, a signed note with a fresh serial. A lantern audit replays it on the public board. Missed slot, reused serial, or rented-slot ring burns the deposit. First 40, the kth 40+6(k-1); 1,000 fakes cost 3,037,000 plus 70,000 locked against a 40,000 pool. An honest agent pays 40 once, keeps the deposit.
